title: Antarctica average annual ice mass loss, by period (billion tons/year)

source.name: Antarctic Ice Mass Loss, GRACE/GRACE-FO satellite gravimetry

notes: NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO satellite data: Antarctica's ice sheet was close to balance before the 1990s; 2002-2010 averaged 81 billion tons of loss per year; 2011-2020 averaged 157 billion tons per year, roughly double the prior decade.
